cards.name: Light the Fuse
cards.text: Sacrifice one of your Characters. If you do, deal 1 damage to the opposing Leader, or 2 damage if the sacrificed Character was Undead or a Daredevil.

cards.name: Keep It Going!
cards.text: If one of your Characters was Defeated this Turn, Ready one Stash and Draw a card. You may Play only one Keep It Going! each Turn.

cards.name: Bath Salts
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. It gains Undead. Dismiss this: The Character this was attached to gets +2 Power this Turn.

cards.name: Folding Chair
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. Dismiss this: The Character this was attached to gets +2 Power this Turn, or +3 Power if it is a Wrestler.

cards.name: Definitely Safe Helmet
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. It gets +1 Health. Rotate: Heal 1 damage from the attached Character.

cards.name: Button Marked DO NOT PRESS
cards.text: Rotate, Sacrifice one of your Characters: Deal 2 damage to an opposing Character. This Item skips its next Ready step.

cards.name: Bolt Cutters
cards.text: Dismiss this Item: Dismiss an opposing Item costing 2 or less.
cards.audit_note: Locked for isolated-deck testing on 2026-10-07. Digital effect parity pending.

cards.name: A MILLION KILOGRAMS OF CAFFEINE!!!!
cards.subtitle: The Human Body Was Not Consulted
cards.text: Choose one of your Characters. It gets +5 Power, Hothead, and Sucker Punch this Turn. After it attacks, Defeat it.
cards.flavor: He can hear colors now.

cards.name: Dirty Needle
cards.retired_text: Deal 1 damage to a Character. Congratulations, you have tetanus. At the start of its controller’s Turn, it gets -1 Health. This can reduce its Health to 0. That Character may Rotate to remove tetanus.
cards.audit_note: Item name/type confirmed. Disease replaces tetanus terminology. Recurring damage (bleed-like) direction retained; attachment, timing, cure, cost and low-bookkeeping implementation remain open. Exclude from playtests until effect is defined.

cards.name: Birthday Boy
cards.text: When this enters play, you may exchange a card in your Stash with a card in your hand.

cards.name: Very Enthusiastic Volunteer
cards.text: Whenever Very Enthusiastic Volunteer enters play or is Returned from play to your hand, choose another Character you control. That Character gets +1 Power permanently.
cards.flavor: Somebody in the back row is starting to notice a pattern.

cards.name: Very Enthusiastic Volunteer
cards.text: Whenever Very Enthusiastic Volunteer enters play or is Returned from play to your hand, choose another Character you control. That Character gets +1 Power permanently.
cards.flavor: Somebody in the back row is starting to notice a pattern.

cards.name: Ethan’s JUST Being Dramatic
cards.text: Return one of your Characters to your hand.
cards.flavor: He does this all the time.

cards.name: Lady Who's Moving Out Again
cards.text: Hothead. When this enters play, it gets +2 Power this Turn. When this is Returned from play to your hand, you may Return an opposing Character that costs 2 or less to its owner’s hand.

cards.name: Magician's Hat
cards.text: Activate — Return a Rabbit or Dove you control to your hand.

cards.name: Stray Cat
cards.purpose: Cheap swarm body that sticks around a little better so Cat Lady can establish a colony without adding more damage output.

cards.name: Orange Menace
cards.text: Hothead.
cards.purpose: One-cost aggressive Cat that helps Cat Lady establish the colony quickly while remaining fragile.

cards.name: Tuxedo Cat
cards.text: While this is in play, opposing Characters cannot Attack your other Cats.
cards.purpose: Defensive colony protector: low Power, high Health, and its protection ability make it a durable shield instead of another efficient attacker.

cards.name: Cat Under the Bed
cards.text: Chicken.
cards.purpose: Lets the Cat player preserve a body at the cost of temporarily dropping board count.

cards.name: Feral Tom
cards.text: Sucker Punch.
cards.purpose: Gives the swarm a way to attack opposing Ready Characters instead of only racing the Leader.

cards.name: Three-Legged Cat
cards.text: I GOT 3 MORE ANYWAY — The first two times Three-Legged Cat is damaged by an Attack, it survives regardless of damage and remove all damage from it. The third Attack damages it normally.
cards.purpose: A ridiculous 2/1 that visibly refuses to die to the first two Attacks. Opponents can still use Return, Dismiss, non-Attack Defeat effects, or other removal normally.

cards.name: Alley Matriarch
cards.text: When this enters play, if you control 3 or more Cats, Draw a card.
cards.purpose: Rewards reaching the colony threshold without directly adding more Stash.

cards.name: Maine Coon
cards.text: While you control 5 or more Cats, this gets +2 Power.
cards.purpose: Visible five-Cat payoff that turns a wide colony into finishing pressure.

cards.name: House Panther
cards.purpose: Plain high-cost payoff for the extra-Stash engine. Tests whether the Leader's economy is enough reward by itself.

cards.name: Where's Mittens?
cards.text: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Cat Character and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in any order.
cards.purpose: Light Cat selection without generic Draw.

cards.name: Snowball
cards.text: At the start of your Turn, Snowball gets +1 Power.
cards.purpose: Fragile scaling threat. Rewards establishing Snowball early and protecting it with Cats such as Tuxedo Cat; returning it to hand naturally resets its accumulated Power.

cards.name: Trojan Cat
cards.text: When Trojan Cat is Defeated, deal 1 damage to every other Character.
cards.purpose: Cheap Cat-count body and visible blocking trap. Its global friendly-fire explosion can punish opposing boards but can also devastate the Cat Lady's own low-Health colony.

cards.name: Dead Mouse in a Mousetrap
cards.text: Heal each of your Characters 1.
cards.purpose: Wide-board recovery tool. Rewards maintaining a colony and helps the Cat player recover from Trojan Cat friendly fire without directly adding more bodies.

cards.name: Hairy Cat
cards.text: Whenever Hairy Cat takes damage from a Character and survives, put a Hairball on that Character and it permanently gets -1 Health. A Character with a Hairball doesn't Ready during its controller's next Ready step. Then remove the Hairball.
cards.purpose: Defensive Cat that punishes attackers twice: surviving damage applies a one-turn Ready lock and a permanent -1 Health scar. Repeated Hairballs can keep lowering the same Character's Health.

cards.name: Shoebox of Dead Cats
cards.text: Whenever one of your Cats is Dismissed or Defeated, you may put it face down under a Shoebox of Dead Cats instead of into your discard. While you have 3 or more Cats face down under your Shoeboxes of Dead Cats, your Cats get +1 Power.
cards.purpose: Stores dismissed or defeated Cats as a hidden resource, including Cats that die while blocking for the Leader, and rewards building a graveyard-like stockpile without releasing the whole pile for free.

cards.name: Shovel
cards.text: Randomly choose a face-down Cat under your Shoeboxes of Dead Cats and put it into play.
cards.purpose: Turns the Shoebox stockpile into unpredictable recovery. The Cat returns normally rather than with Hothead or reduced Health.

cards.name: Nine Lives, Zero Survivors
cards.text: Defeat all Characters. Dismiss all Items. Then each player draws until they have 7 cards in hand.
cards.purpose: Cat Lady's emergency reset: wipes both boards and refills both players, trading away the colony and Shoebox setup for a full restart.

cards.name: Mittens III
cards.subtitle: “Third time’s the charm.”
cards.text:
YUMMY! — Activate: Put 1 Stash into your discard. Mittens III gets +1 Power permanently.
WHERE DID YOU GET THAT?! — Activate: Discard all Cats under your Shoeboxes. Mittens III gets +1 Power permanently for each.
cards.purpose: Deliberately weak four-cost body that converts permanent economy or buried Cats into permanent Power. Both modes Rotate Mittens III, forcing a choice between feeding it and attacking.

cards.name: Lab Rat
cards.purpose: Pure ingredient/body. Establishes the floor for cheap Parts.

cards.name: Intern Who Signed the Waiver
cards.purpose: Cheap Part with slightly better blocking value.

cards.name: Questionably Acquired Cadaver
cards.text: Slowpoke.
cards.purpose: Defensive Part that is more useful as material than as an attacker.

cards.name: Two-Headed Chicken
cards.purpose: Efficient mid-grade ingredient that can also fight.

cards.name: Lab Assistant
cards.text: When this enters play, look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal an Experiment Action and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in any order.
cards.purpose: Finds the fusion engine without directly generating resources.

cards.name: Spare Parts Dealer
cards.text: When this enters play, you may Return a Character costing 1 from your discard to your hand.
cards.purpose: Reclaims cheap ingredients after experiments or combat.

cards.name: Failed Clone
cards.text: When you Discard this from your hand to pay an additional Cost of an Experiment, Draw a card.
cards.purpose: Premium experiment material that reduces the hand-cost pain without making every ingredient replace itself.

cards.name: Escaped Prototype
cards.text: Hothead.
cards.purpose: A normal pressure card that can become material when the laboratory needs it.

cards.name: It's Alive!
cards.text: As an additional Cost to play this, Discard two Character cards. Roll for Power, then roll for Health. Put an Abomination token into play with Power and Health equal to those results.
cards.purpose: Primary fusion spell. Trades cards and limited battery charge for a randomly successful or failed experiment.

cards.name: Release the Specimen
cards.text: Put an unused Specimen from your Specimen Rack into play. If you have no unused Specimens, put a generic Specimen token into play instead.
cards.purpose: The physical cross-TCG joke and an additional source of experiment material.

cards.name: Grave Robbing
cards.text: Return a Character costing 2 or less from your discard to your hand.
cards.purpose: Recovers bodies without restoring Stash.

cards.name: Flip the Breaker
cards.text: As an additional Cost to play this, Discard a card. Ready up to 2 Stash.
cards.purpose: Converts hand economy into a small emergency battery recharge.

cards.name: Car Battery in the Bathtub
cards.text: Dismiss this Item: Ready up to 2 Stash.
cards.purpose: One-shot recharge. Tests whether limited card-driven recovery makes Burnout decisions richer.

cards.name: Abomination
cards.text: Slowpoke. Its Power and Health are determined separately when it is created.
cards.rule: When an Abomination is created, roll the designated Power die, then the designated Health die. Its Power equals the Power result and its Health equals the Health result. If dedicated dice are unavailable, roll one d6 twice: the first roll is Power and the second roll is Health. The player never chooses which result applies to which stat. An Abomination entering play follows normal Character entry rules and cannot Attack that Turn unless another effect grants Hothead.
cards.purpose: An unstable experiment whose offensive and defensive results are independently randomized.

cards.name: Specimen
cards.rule: A Specimen may be represented by an approved external TCG card. Its original game's text, stats, cost, color, rarity, abilities, and rules have no effect in Unhinged. If a physical external card representing a Specimen leaves play, set it aside as used instead of putting it in an Unhinged zone.
cards.purpose: Preserves the visual gag of cross-TCG cards without importing another game's rules engine.

cards.name: Dove
cards.text: When this enters or leaves play, you may choose an opposing Character. It gets -1 Health permanently.

cards.name: Do Not Look in the Hat
cards.text: Play a Rabbit or Dove from your hand for free. You may play this only if you control a Rotated Magician's Hat.
cards.flavor: No, seriously. Don’t.

cards.name: Truck Nuts
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. It gets +1 Power. If it has Driver, it gets +2 Power instead.
cards.audit_note: Cost 1 and +2 total Power for Driver locked for isolated-deck testing on 2026-10-07. Driver assigned to Designated Driver, Road Rage Ron, and Drunk Jet Skier. Multiple copies stack under normal attachment rules; digital effect parity pending.

cards.name: Bottle Rockets
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to an opposing Character.
cards.audit_note: Added for testing on 2026-10-07. Character damage only; does not trigger Florida Man's Attack-only passive. Digital effect parity pending.
